generic_name: Ascorbic Acid, Cholecalciferol, and Alpha-Tocopherol (Vitamins C, D3, and E)
purpose: This combination of vitamins helps your body stay healthy by providing three important nutrients it needs every day. Vitamin C supports your immune system and helps wounds heal, Vitamin D3 keeps your bones and teeth strong, and Vitamin E acts as an antioxidant to protect your cells from damage. Doctors often recommend this when your diet may not be giving you enough of these vitamins.
how_it_works: Think of these three vitamins as a team working together in your body. Vitamin C helps your body build collagen, which is like the glue that holds your tissues together, and it also helps fight off illness. Vitamin D3 helps your body absorb calcium so your bones stay strong, while Vitamin E protects your cells from harmful molecules called free radicals that can cause damage over time.
common_side_effects: These vitamins are generally very well tolerated. At normal doses, side effects are rare, but some people may experience mild stomach upset, nausea, or diarrhea, especially if taken on an empty stomach. Taking them with food can help reduce any stomach discomfort.
warnings: Do not take more than the recommended dose, as too much Vitamin C can cause kidney stones and digestive problems, too much Vitamin D can raise calcium levels to dangerous levels in your blood, and too much Vitamin E can interfere with blood clotting. Tell your doctor if you have kidney disease, take blood thinners like warfarin, or have any conditions that affect how your body absorbs nutrients. Always keep supplements out of reach of children.
typical_dosing: Dosing varies depending on your age and health needs. For most adults, a common daily dose is around 60-90 mg of Vitamin C, 600-800 IU of Vitamin D3, and 15 mg of Vitamin E, but your doctor or pharmacist may recommend a different amount based on your specific situation. Always follow the directions on the label or as your healthcare provider has told you, and take with food to help with absorption and reduce stomach upset.
